interleave: all five arms share one window, one serving process and one turn sequence; no restart separates arms (live-first-control-plan.md 2.4); each attached arm interleaves its own capture -> publish -> attach cycle; the order below is fixed by plan 4.3 and may not be rotated or changed after arm 1 has run (1.4)

operator_step.N-none: remove the control file before the turn; the control path must hold NO file
operator_step.F-text: control file absent; nothing is written to the control path
operator_step.T-exact: write arms/control-T-exact.txt (bytes 'texact\n') to the control path
operator_step.T-norm: write arms/control-T-norm.txt (bytes 'tnorm\n') to the control path
operator_step.N-shape: write arms/control-N-shape.txt (bytes 'nshape\n') to the control path, remove the file after the turn

turn_id_grammar.seq: 4-digit zero-padded, allocated strictly in execution order

sessions.note: one source session for all three captures (family_id of every P3 corpus row would be the source session; latent_worker.py:389 capture.submit passes source_session_id as family)

turns.operator_step_before: write control-T-exact.txt to the control path

wire_ids.tool_call_id: <id of the single occ3_handoff call in turn t0003>

turns.operator_step_before: write control-T-norm.txt to the control path

wire_ids.tool_call_id: <id of the single occ3_handoff call in turn t0005>

turns.operator_step_before: write control-N-shape.txt to the control path

wire_ids.tool_call_id: <id of the single occ3_handoff call in turn t0007>

turns.operator_step_before: remove the control file after the turn

determinism: source decode temperature 0 + seed 1234; the three source captures must carry the same accepted_sequence_digest (plan 2.5); a mismatch stops the phase as a framing-equality failure
repeat_rule: a repeated arm is a new declared window with a new id and re-runs all five arms in the same order (plan 4.3); turn ids never repeat because the window id is part of every id

evidence.note: driver appends one record per submitted turn (arm, turn_id, wire ids, request sha256, status, finish_reason, answer class, receipt summary, control-file readings, timings)
